name: Tooltip
summary: A short description shown on hover or keyboard focus, read with or without script.

guidance.useFor: A short description of a control on hover or keyboard focus, usually an icon button.
insteadUse: Anything people need, including on touch: Toggletip or visible text
content: A few words that add to the control's name ("Saves a draft; nothing is published")

rungReason: aria-describedby and popover are native; showing on hover and focus with a delay, hover persistence and Escape (WCAG 1.4.13) need the data-lue-tooltip behaviour.

a11y.name: n/a
a11y.description: It describes its trigger (aria-describedby), shown or not

keyboard.action: Focusing the trigger shows it at once; moving on hides it
Hide it, keeping focus (and only it: a dialog it's in stays open)

elementRules: The behaviour opens and closes the popover and writes nothing. Hover shows it after 300 ms, focus at once; it stays while the pointer is over the trigger or the tooltip.
rules: Never on touch: anything a user needs belongs in a Toggletip
Text only, nothing to act on
An icon-only button still needs its own name (aria-label); the tooltip is its description
withoutJavaScript: Not shown; the description is still read
contrast: The inverse surface passes the -more levels
deletionTrigger: interestfor and popover="hint" in all three engines
